evidence: Modifies SigningProvider and PSBT handling in descriptorprocesspsbt and utxoupdatepsbt.
rationale: Fixes a privacy and metadata leak where MuSig2 aggregate pubkeys and participant BIP 32 derivation paths from unrelated descriptors were injected into PSBT inputs. The PR resolves issue #36323 by verifying aggregate pubkey involvement before attaching MuSig2 data to the PSBT.
